entries.final_answer: A kernel Tension value held beside the structural relationships in DoctrineGraph (no RelationType, no HTTP contract change). Rationale: ADR-0028 D3 counts tension apart from the one-structural-relationship-per-pair identity, so it is not a Relationship of another type; it keeps RelationType, Relation and the Relation.yaml enum unchanged and /relationships neither accepts nor answers a new token (the brief reserves an HTTP contract change for the operator). The pack spelling in_tension_with stays a storage concern (ADR-0036 D4). Recorded by the mission agent under the brief's 'stop only at genuine decisions' rule; logged as an open review item for operator confirmation in the PR.
